verdict.rationale: Evidence only confirms that applications can be advanced, moved, and rejected via the API (docs-1, docs-20, docs-29), which implies basic pipeline-stage movement, but there is no documentation of configurable custom stages per job, a drag-and-drop UI, or bulk actions across a pipeline. Missing for 10: custom per-job stage configuration, drag-to-move UI evidence, and bulk-action tooling across candidates.
